Slumber Party Program: pre-approved adoption applicants can host a dog for one night up to two weeks; the agreement and handbook are on the page. Shelter on N. Gale St, Westfield is open Mon-Sat 1-3pm; email rather than call. The page footer reads (c) 2021, so confirm the program is still running.
